author: Hans Holbein the Younger
description:
Two Studies of the Left Hand of Erasmus of Rotterdam; Study of the Right Hand Writing.   Silverpoint , black crayon and red chalk on grey-primed paper,  20.6 × 15.3 cm ,  Louvre , Paris.
This sketch, along with  one of the right hand , can be linked with Holbein's   Portrait of Erasmus with Renaissance Pilaster  . The writing hand drawn in black crayon may have been added later (Müller, pp. 288–89).
